name: Camp Romaca
description_short: All girls overnight camp in Hinsdale, in the Berkshires, running a single seven week season. Campers split their days between sports, gymnastics, arts, horseback riding, adventure and the Plunkett Lake waterfront, with younger girls on a set schedule and older girls choosing their own.
swim_waterfront_notes: The waterfront is on Plunkett Lake, with two shallow areas, deep water for advanced instruction, racing lanes, a water slide and a Wibit. Campers have Red Cross swim instruction and an afternoon free swim. Water skiing, kneeboarding, wakeboarding, sailing, canoeing and paddleboarding are offered. Lifeguards and Water Safety Instructors run a double check buddy system.
refund_policy_summary: All tuition and fees are non-refundable after September 15. Tuition and program cancellation insurance is offered through the application.
